newsitem.title: USA: NFL-SUPER BOWL MATCH-UPS FOR GREEN BAY-NEW ENGLAND GAME.
newsitem.headline: NFL-SUPER BOWL MATCH-UPS FOR GREEN BAY-NEW ENGLAND GAME.

text.p: Background for Sunday's Super Bowl championship between the Green Bay Packers and New England Patriots:
New England (13-5) vs. Green Bay (15-3) at the Superdome starting 6:18 pm EST (2318 gmt)
New England postseason:
Beat Pittsburgh 28-3 in the AFC divisional playoff. Curtis Martin rushed for 165 yards and three touchdowns and the Patriots defence recorded two interceptions.

Beat Jacksonville 20-6 in the AFC Championship game. The Patriots defence, which has not allowed a touchdown in the postseason, forced four turnovers. Cornerback Otis Smith grabbed a fumble out of the air and returned it 47 yards for a touchdown and special teams set up 10 of New England's points.
Green Bay postseason:

Beat San Francisco 35-14 in the divisional playoffs. Desmond Howard returned a punt 71 yards for a touchdown and set up another score with a 46-yard punt return and the Green Bay defence forced five turnovers. Edgar Bennett rushed for 80 yards and two touchdowns on 17 carries for the Packers.

Beat Carolina 30-13 in the NFC Championship game. QB Brett Favre passed for two touchdowns and RB Dorsey Levens emerged as the unlikely star with 205 yards in total offence. Levens caught five passes for 117 yards and rushed for 88 yards on 10 carries.
Last Meeting: In Week 5 at Foxboro Stadium on October 2, 1994, Matt Bahr kicked a 33-yard field goal with four seconds left to lift the Patriots to a 17-16 victory.
New England's Drew Bledsoe completed 29-of-53 passes for 334 yards and two touchdowns with an interception. Favre was 25-of-47 for 294 yards and a touchdown with two interceptions.
Super Bowl appearances

New England - lost to the Chicago Bears 46-10 in Super Bowl XX at New Orleans in January 1986. The Bears tied a Super Bowl record with seven sacks and limited the Patriots to a record-low seven rushing yards. Jim McMahon, now a backup QB for the Packers, rushed for two touchdowns and passed for 256 yards.

Green Bay - Beat the Kansas City Chiefs 35-10 in Super Bowl I at Los Angeles in January 1967. Bart Starr completed 16-of-23 passes for 250 yards and two touchdowns to earn MVP. Max McGee, filling in for injured Boyd Dowler, caught seven passes for 138 yards and two touchdowns. Elijah Pitts ran for two scores and Willie Wood had 50-yard interception return.

Beat the Oakland Raiders 33-14 in Super Bowl II at Miami in January 1968. Bart Starr again MVP as he completed 13 of 24 passes for 202 yards, including a 62-yard touchdown to Boyd Dowler. Don Chandler kicked four field goals and Herb Adderley returned an interception 60 yards for a score. Game marked the last for Vince Lombardi as Packers coach, ending nine years at Green Bay in which he won five NFL titles and two Super Bowls.
Coaches Playoff Records: Bill Parcells, NE, 10-4
Mike Holmgren, GB, 6-3
Coaches Super Bowl Records: Bill Parcells, NE, 2-0
Mike Holmgren, GB, 0-0

Coaching Tidbits: New England's Bill Parcells attempting to become the first coach in NFL history to win Super Bowls with two franchises. Parcells, in his fourth year with New England, coached New York Giants to wins in Super Bowls XXI and XXV. Don Shula is only other coach to take two franchises to Super Bowl, coaching Miami Dolphins to five Super Bowls and two titles and guiding Baltimore Colts to Super Bowl III.

Green Bay's Mike Holmgren was offensive coordinator for San Francisco's back-to-back Super Bowl-winning teams after the 1988 and 1989 seasons. The 49ers beat Cincinnati 20-16 in Super Bowl XXIII at Miami and defeated Denver 55-10 in Super Bowl XXIV at New Orleans.
